additional_checks.description: Eight simultaneous real-model API requests with independent session cookies completed correctly; eight cross-session turn reads returned 404. This is a small demo sanity check, not production-capacity evidence.

Real-model 12-question memory regression answered all 12 expected queries correctly; after social noise, an ordinal follow-up matched independent gold with 31 daily rows and the expected daily-metric sum.

limitations: Observed latency is not an established SLO; measure p50/p95 under representative class concurrency before making a capacity claim.
No independent human-authored holdout has been evaluated; the current suites are small and should not be presented as broad evidence of generalization.
Memory and clarification v3 ablations are invalid for comparative claims; see regression-v3/validity.json.
